与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:伊娃的经历、感受与成长。

The cashier has become an important part of daily life. On Thursday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The meeting is scheduled for nine on Monday.

Little by little, things began to change. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The discount area looked quieter than usual that evening. Best of all, my nephew wore his superhero cape everywhere for an entire summer.

The experience taught Eva more than any book could. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The resort was overpriced and tired.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Max and Eva are preparing a report about the discount area. Eva has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. He owns all the trappings of wealth but feels lonely.
Eva is saving money to buy a ticket to London. People around Eva often share different ideas about the discount area. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
